results.name: FTheory.SU5.TenQuanta.anomalyCoefficient
results.source_text:
/--
  The anomaly coefficient of a `TenQuanta` is given by the pair of integers:
  `(∑ᵢ qᵢ Nᵢ, 3 * ∑ᵢ qᵢ² Nᵢ)`.

  The first components is for the mixed U(1)-MSSM, see equation (22) of arXiv:1401.5084.
  The second component is for the mixed U(1)Y-U(1)-U(1) gauge anomaly,
    see equation (23) of arXiv:1401.5084.
-/
def anomalyCoefficient (F : TenQuanta 𝓩) : 𝓩 × 𝓩 :=
  ((F.map fun x => x.2.2 • x.1).sum, 3 * (F.map fun x => x.2.2 • (x.1 * x.1)).sum)
results.docstring:
The anomaly coefficient of a `TenQuanta` is given by the pair of integers:
`(∑ᵢ qᵢ Nᵢ, 3 * ∑ᵢ qᵢ² Nᵢ)`.

The first components is for the mixed U(1)-MSSM, see equation (22) of arXiv:1401.5084.
The second component is for the mixed U(1)Y-U(1)-U(1) gauge anomaly,
  see equation (23) of arXiv:1401.5084.

results.name: FTheory.SU5.Quanta.HuAnomalyCoefficient
results.source_text:
/-- The pair of anomaly cancellation coefficients associated with the `Hu` particle. -/
def HuAnomalyCoefficient [CommRing 𝓩] (qHu : Option 𝓩) : 𝓩 × 𝓩 :=
  match qHu with
  | none => (0, 0)
  | some qHu => (-qHu, -qHu ^ 2)
results.docstring: The pair of anomaly cancellation coefficients associated with the `Hu` particle.

results.name: FTheory.SU5.Quanta.HdAnomalyCoefficient_map

@[simp]
lemma HdAnomalyCoefficient_map {𝓩 𝓩1 : Type} [CommRing 𝓩] [CommRing 𝓩1]
    (f : 𝓩 →+* 𝓩1) (qHd : Option 𝓩) :
    HdAnomalyCoefficient (qHd.map f) = (f.prodMap f) (HdAnomalyCoefficient qHd) := by
  cases qHd <;> simp [HdAnomalyCoefficient]

results.name: AdjoinRoot
results.source_text:
/-- Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`. -/
def AdjoinRoot [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) : Type _ :=
  Polynomial R ⧸ (span {f} : Ideal R[X])
results.docstring:
Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`.

results.name: AdjoinRoot.isRoot_root
results.source_text:
theorem isRoot_root (f : R[X]) : IsRoot (f.map (of f)) (root f) := by
  rw [IsRoot, eval_map, eval₂_root]

results.name: AdjoinRoot.quotAdjoinRootEquivQuotPolynomialQuot
results.source_text:
/-- The natural isomorphism `R[α]/I[α] ≅ (R/I)[X]/(f mod I)` for `α` a root of `f : R[X]`
  and `I : Ideal R`. -/
def quotAdjoinRootEquivQuotPolynomialQuot :
    AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I.map (of f) ≃+*
    (R ⧸ I)[X] ⧸ span ({f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)} : Set (R ⧸ I)[X]) :=
  (quotMapOfEquivQuotMapCMapMk I f).trans
    ((quotMapCMapSpanMkEquivQuotMapCQuotMapMk I f).trans
      ((Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (by rw [map_span, Set.image_singleton])).trans
        (Polynomial.quotQuotEquivComm I f).symm))
results.docstring:
The natural isomorphism `R[α]/I[α] ≅ (R/I)[X]/(f mod I)` for `α` a root of `f : R[X]`
and `I : Ideal R`.

/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
